posts.body_html: Apparently, this clone is far more amazing than I originally thought! I wasn't ever really into growing giant specimens, but figured there were so many divisions in the collection, why not put this in an enormous amount of soil and allow a nice sized specimen to develop over a few years? Well, that's what happened and it turned into this thing, as impressive as what you'd see in the wild! Dang, SON!
